key.name: files-patterns
key.description: List of pre-defined patterns available in the 'Pattern' entry.

key.name: regex-patterns
key.description: List of last patterns used in the 'Regex' entry.

key.name: substitution-patterns
key.description: List of last patterns used in the 'Substitution' entry.

key.name: textview-font
key.description: The font used in the file editor.

key.name: match-color
key.description: The background color used to highlight matches of the search expression.

key.name: current-match-color
key.description: The background color used to highlight the currently selected match of the search expression.

key.name: fallback-encoding
key.description: Name of the character encoding to use if a file is not readable in either UTF-8 or the codeset specified by the current locale. Try "iconv --list" for a complete list of possible values.

key.name: window-position-x
key.description: The X coordinate of the window.

key.name: window-position-y
key.description: The Y coordinate of the window.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Whether to show the line numbers of the text view.

key.name: highlight-current-line
key.description: Whether to highlight the current line of the text view.

key.name: auto-indentation
key.description: Whether to enable auto indentation in the text view.

key.name: draw-space
key.description: Which type of space to draw in the text view.

key.name: preferred-language
key.description: Language code for the user interface (e.g. fr, de). Empty means system default. Requires a restart.
